name: Autocomplete
purpose: Searchable combobox with debounced async queries, pagination, and keyboard navigation.

props.name: string: form field name
props.searchOptions: (params: { query: string; page: number; size: number }) => Promise<{ items: T[]; ... }>
props.label: string: field label

rules: Always supply a unique name for form accessibility.
Provide clear empty message when query yields no results.
